test_set: 24 synthetic digital PDFs (11 clean, 13 with injected issues), fixed random seed 2026, listed in evaluation/test_set/manifest.json
methodology: Fictional invoices are generated by this script. Ground truth is what each PDF prints plus the issues deliberately injected (missing date, invoice number or supplier; total different from subtotal + tax). The real pipeline (PDF text, regex field extraction, deterministic checks) runs on every file. Issues: detected = injected issues that were flagged, missed = injected issues not flagged, false alerts = flags with no injected issue. Field accuracy = printed fields read exactly (amounts compared numerically). Layouts vary on purpose (Vendor/Supplier/Seller, Total/Grand Total/Total Amount, currency prefixes). Digital PDFs only: scanned-image OCR quality is not measured here, and results on synthetic data do not predict accuracy on real invoices.
